disputes.topic: Source provenance and temporal coverage cannot be reproduced
disputes.issue: No source URL/acquisition record, original video, source-aligned snapshots, or reproducible split procedure is retained. The three part durations and 00:00–34:10 continuous coverage claim are therefore unverified.
disputes.required_resolution: Provide source provenance and the original media or durable source references; reproduce the exact part boundaries and durations; retain source-aligned snapshots and manifests; reconcile gaps/overlaps before creating a unified timeline.

disputes.topic: Four cross-part identity correspondences lack retained evidence
disputes.issue: The four global identities link three packet-scoped records each, but source frames are absent and the part TIR hypotheses are explicitly provisional/unverified. Clothing/position continuity and the high correspondence ratings cannot be independently reviewed.
disputes.required_resolution: Re-investigate each proposed correspondence using source-aligned evidence. Retain competing candidates, discriminating observations and unresolved cases. Commit global identity only when evidence supports equivalence; otherwise preserve packet-scoped IDs as separate or unresolved.

disputes.topic: Merged timeline and storage-reduction claims are not evidence-equivalent
disputes.issue: The merged TD asserts visibility across each interval and the family historically claimed a 10,000x storage reduction. The source video and snapshots are absent, and packet-only metadata excludes evidence required for audit; neither continuous visibility nor an evidence-equivalent reduction is established.
evidence: MERGED_Global/TIR.json: temporal continuity and storage comparison status
